description: This file defines the Dispatcher class and related classes for managing SDK object dispatching, event handling, and communication with the underlying protocol in Playwright's server architecture.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Generic dispatcher class managing SDK objects, event dispatching, and protocol communication.

classes.name: RootDispatcher
classes.description: Specialized dispatcher for the root scope, initializing Playwright.

classes.name: DispatcherConnection
classes.description: Manages dispatchers, message passing, and protocol validation.

methods.name: setMaxDispatchersForTest
methods.description: Overrides maximum dispatchers per GC bucket for testing.

methods.name: maxDispatchersForBucket
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed dispatchers for a given GC bucket.

methods.name: _runCommand
methods.description: Executes a command with progress tracking.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes the dispatcher and its children.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event through the protocol.

methods.name: sendCreate
methods.description: Sends a create message for a new dispatcher.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages and routes them to the appropriate dispatcher.
